notes: Independent asset review of all 26 named Part D files; no weather16 output was edited. Read BRIEF-16 in full and the earlier-round drawing/reduction method sections in NOTES. Inspected every file at exact native 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x, with 8x fork/edge/tip close-ups. Inspected all 26 native placements over each of the seven reference crops: fantasy grass, forest, town, modern city, wasteland, desert sand and snow. Decoded and inspected all nine bolt GIF sequences over dark clouds, city and town and all four gust GIF sequences over grass, including their encoded timing; this is frame/timing review, not a claim of live in-engine playback. Also explicitly inspected the wind f3-to-f0 transition. All required dimensions pass; the 25 bolt/gust sprites have only alpha 0/255, all 26 files have zero RGB under transparency, and each bolt's f0/f1/f2 alpha channels are byte-identical. No detached 1-4 pixel alpha specks were found. The flash is accepted under the explicit discrete-ring exception: alpha 0/8/16/28/44/64/88, crisp band boundaries, approximately 5.89% alpha-weighted canvas coverage, readable underlying map, and no smooth antialiased ramp. Native stroke scale, drawn curl/bolt shapes and map readability otherwise pass. The three afterglow failures are visual despite decreasing raw RGB luminance. The wind endpoint failures apply the user's explicit smooth four-frame-loop review requirement; the source brief's sprite wording and the creator's five-frame event previews do not demonstrate that closure. Middle wind frames pass individually, but the four sequences require endpoint repair. Part D has no ground tiles, seasonal props or seasonal partners: literal 3x3 ground repeats and summer/seasonal alpha comparisons are not applicable; curves in these effect sprites are not rounded grid-tile corners. Only critic-r16D-1.json and critic-r16D-1-*.png review composites were written. No commit, push or branch change.
